title: A Temporal Convolutional Network with Multi-Head Attention Model: A Surrogate for Parallel DEVS Semiconductor Fab Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.20493v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Semiconductor factories process many kinds of wafers organized into lots of various sizes and configurations. Different kinds of machines, each with its own operations, process wafers for hours to days, and the wafers undergo many incremental fabrication steps (with re-entry) and flows spanning days to weeks across connected machines. Fast and accurate predictions of throughput ($TH$) and turnaround time ($TA$) dynamics for individual machines and their combinations are essential for factory operations. To use machine learning methods for this purpose, this paper presents a Temporal Convolutional Network with Multi-head Attention (TCNA) architecture. It uses simulated datasets from a benchmark Parallel DEVS (PDEVS) semiconductor fabrication factory model. translated_title: 带多头注意力机制的时间卷积网络模型：并行DEVS半导体晶圆厂仿真的代理模型
translated_abstract: 半导体工厂处理多种晶圆，这些晶圆被组织成不同尺寸和配置的批次。不同类型的机器各自执行特定的操作，晶圆的加工需要数小时至数天，且晶圆需经历许多增量制造步骤（包括重入）并在相互连接的机器之间流转，整个过程持续数天至数周。对单台机器及其组合的产出率（$TH$）和周转时间（$TA$）动态进行快速而准确的预测对工厂运营至关重要。为此，本文提出了一种带多头注意力机制的时间卷积网络（TCNA）架构，以运用机器学习方法实现这一目标。该模型使用来自基准并行DEVS（PDEVS）半导体制造工厂模型的仿真数据集。该工厂处理可配置的晶圆批次，晶圆到达模式包括均匀分布和正弦分布，并可能进行预防性维护。晶圆批次大小、到达模式以及工厂（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种带多头注意力机制的时间卷积网络（TCNA）模型，作为并行DEVS半导体晶圆厂仿真的代理模型，能够快速准确地预测产出率和周转时间的动态变化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Temporal Convolutional Network with Multi-head Attention (TCNA) model as a surrogate for Parallel DEVS semiconductor fab simulation, enabling fast and accurate prediction of throughput and turnaround time dynamics.
